items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And Chani, me, and Chester and Joe Stratton.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Ask him who was in the band when Muck Carey was in the band, I'd be. Right. Yeah, when he finishes there. Then I, uh. He said who was in the band when Muck Carey was there?

Yeah. I'd be, when he was with Jack. Yeah. He was with his brother there. Yeah. And Chani, me, and Chester and Joe Stratton. No, Chester and, uh, that was, let's see. Mm-hm. He was with Jack when he come with him wasn't he? Something was mad all down there you know. Sip of lettuce you know. And he died you know. He had to stop playing.
And the drummer? Chinese. You said Chinese.
